title: Hold the first close
summary: Admit the first group of investors to a fund or a multi-closing offering and start the clocks that run from it.
outlineSteps: List the conditions to closing in the offering documents
Read the later-closing terms in the governing agreement
Confirm each condition to closing is met
Confirm every subscription in the first close is accepted and funded
Have counsel confirm the close can proceed
Have a person approve each release of funds
Admit the first investors on the entity's records
Record the close in the investor register
Calendar the deadlines that run from the first close
Send each admitted investor confirmation of the close
File the closing record and keep it
